text:
ben: hey team — running into a weird runtime error after we started shading the kotlin client jar + keeping retrofit-gson for legacy endpoints. DuplicateClass (LinkageError) for jackson classes when streaming NDJSON via OkHttp. anyone seen this?

alice: can you paste the stack trace and the shadow config? sounds like relocation didn't catch all packages or there's a mixed-serializer situation.

ben: stack trace snippet: 
ben: ```
java.lang.LinkageError: loader constraint violation: when resolving method "com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper.readTree"
	at com.redwood.client.stream.JsonLineParser.parse(JsonLineParser.kt:42)
	at com.redwood.client.stream.StreamProcessor.process(StreamProcessor.kt:27)
	...
```

carla: are you shading both com.fasterxml.jackson and com.google.gson? If retrofit still brings in GsonConverterFactory you'll end up with two different JSON libs on the classpath and sometimes the runtime picks the wrong one for converters.

ben: we relocated jackson stuff but not gson (left gson to be provided by app). The client library itself uses Jackson for models. The failing path is while reading server NDJSON chunks: we get half a line and then JsonParseException later.

emily: streaming + mixed converters can be subtle. Retrofit converter factories are per-Retrofit instance; make sure the client module constructs Retrofit with the JacksonConverterFactory only. If another module wires in GsonConverterFactory into the same app classloader, that can do weird things at runtime.

carla: also check META-INF/services and any ServiceLoader usage. Shadowing often needs to relocate or merge those files otherwise a different provider may be loaded.

ben: current okhttp config snippet: 
ben: ```kotlin
val client = OkHttpClient.Builder()
  .readTimeout(0, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS) // streaming
  .retryOnConnectionFailure(true)
  .addInterceptor(SpanInterceptor())
  .build()
```

alice: for streaming NDJSON, avoid reading entire body as string. Use BufferedSource/lineIterator and feed each line to ObjectMapper. Also be careful with interceptors that replace the body (e.g., for logging) — they can buffer the stream and change timing.

carla: quick shadow suggestion: relocate both libs explicitly: 
carla: ```groovy
shadowJar {
  relocate 'com.fasterxml.jackson', 'com.redwood.shaded.com.fasterxml.jackson'
  relocate 'com.google.gson', 'com.redwood.shaded.com.google.gson'
  mergeServiceFiles()
}
```

emily: good point about mergeServiceFiles(). If you don't, SPI entries in META-INF/services can point to the unshaded impl and break.

ben: quick workaround that fixed my local repro: force the client module to use JacksonConverterFactory only and exclude retrofit-converter-gson from the client artifact. Tests passed for a small NDJSON stream.

dev-bot: build #5821 — :x: failed in :client:shadowJar — DuplicateClass: com.fasterxml.jackson.core.JsonFactory (see CI link)

emily: CI failure confirms it's not only local. Ben, can you push a PR removing the gson converter from the client artifact and add shaded relocations for both libs? add a small streaming integration test that pipes a 10k-line NDJSON.

ben: yeah I'll open PR in 15m — will include shadow relocate for jackson & gson, mergeServiceFiles(), and an integration that streams 10k small JSON objects to ensure no partial-line parsing issues.

alice: ping @carla @emily for review once it's up. also add a note in README about consumer apps that still expect gson to not include the converter by default.

carla: another thing — interceptor order matters: application interceptors vs network interceptors. If you're wrapping response bodies for tracing in an application interceptor, it may buffer. For streaming, prefer network interceptors when you need to observe bytes without consuming them.

ben: good call, I'll switch the tracing interceptor to network scope in the PR and add a comment.

emily: thanks — I can review tonight. if we merge quick we should re-run the large integration matrix (dedicated/private) to make sure shading doesn't clash on customer deployments that also shade jackson.

ben: thx all. PR link when ready. :thumbsup:
